verdict.rationale: Switching between board, list, calendar and timeline views is a fair question for a work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents Asana's project views. The only mention of 'boards and task lists' (asana-comm-1) describes a different product that is said to replace Asana, so it is not evidence for Asana's own views. Calendar and timeline views are never mentioned.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
